outcome: Content of lactic acid bacteria with probiotic characteristics in meconium
cohort: The study cohort consisted of newborns delivered by either vaginal birth or cesarean section, from whom meconium samples were collected.
finding: Newborns delivered vaginally had a greater development of lactic acid bacteria colonies with probiotic characteristics in their meconium compared to those born by cesarean section.
mod_finding: Vaginal birth was associated with a significantly greater development of lactic acid bacteria with probiotic characteristics in newborn meconium compared to cesarean birth.
cross-section timing: Shortly after birth (meconium samples from neonates)
